0022600040.text: The San Antonio Spurs (10-2, 1st in the Southwest) host the Golden State Warriors (8-4, 6th in the West) in this Emirates NBA Cup West Group C regular-season game, with the Spurs riding a 10-game winning streak, 6-0 on the road and 4-2 at home. Spurs Jayden Quaintance (knee, surgery) and Tobias Harris (calf strain) are out, and Devin Vassell is day-to-day with a groin injury and a game-time decision. For Golden State, Brandon Williams (hamstring), Jimmy Butler III (knee, surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (illness), Moses Moody (knee, surgery), and Stephen Curry (abdomen) are out, and Gary Payton II is day-to-day with knee inflammation and a game-time decision. The teams split their 2025-26 season series 2-2, and the Spurs won the last meeting 127-113 in San Francisco on April 1, 2026, while no games have been played yet in the 2026-27 season series.
